groups.name: notification.store.jdbc
groups.description: JDBC-backed idempotency, dead-letter and delivery-event stores. Active when notification.store.type=jdbc.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.schema
properties.description: Database schema that holds the tables. Unset or blank uses the connection's search path. Must be a plain SQL identifier.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.table-prefix
properties.description: Prefix prepended to every table, constraint and index name. Letters, digits and '_' only.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.datasource-bean-name
properties.description: Name of the DataSource bean the stores use. Unset or blank selects the application's single, or @Primary, DataSource.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.dialect
properties.description: SQL dialect. Only POSTGRESQL is implemented.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.dead-letter-retention
properties.description: How long a dead-letter row is kept. Expired rows are hidden from reads and deleted by the purge.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.delivery-event-retention
properties.description: How long a delivery-event row is kept. Expired rows are hidden from reads and deleted by the purge.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.purge.enabled
properties.description: Run a module-owned scheduled purge of expired rows. Does not require @EnableScheduling.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.purge.interval
properties.description: Delay between scheduled purge runs. The first run happens one interval after startup.

properties.name: notification.store.jdbc.purge.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum rows deleted per purge statement.
